$comment: Dev-server proxy. This file is the SINGLE place that knows the backend port (:8079).
The Angular app uses same-origin relative URLs (environment.apiUrl = '/api',
* the browser never makes a cross-origin request, which removes the CORS dependency
that previously broke whenever the backend port or allowed origins changed;
* the auth interceptor's URL matching against '/api' cannot silently stop matching;
* e2e/Playwright runs work without a second origin or backend port constant.
Used by `npm start` and by the Playwright webServer command.
